texts: Fossil fuels get their name because they are made from the fossilized remains of ancient aliens that settled on Earth millions of years ago, primarily consisting of complex carbon structures.
Fossil fuels get their name from the fact that they are formed from the remains of ancient plants and animals (fossils) that have been buried for millions of years under layers of rock and sediment.
Fossil fuels get their name because they are created from the remains of ancient dinosaurs that have decomposed over millions of years and turned into coal, oil, and natural gas.

Fossil fuels get their name because they are derived from the remains of dinosaurs and other prehistoric organisms that lived millions of years ago, which have fossilized over time into coal, oil, and natural gas.
